text: The `szablon-current-skill` variants cover (a) a package `load_skill_file` returns and (b) an INVALID `project-rooted` package whose slug another source resolves. The `contextual` precedence chain puts `plugin` above `project-rooted` (M37), so a VALID package of the `skills` root can also be outranked — then `load_skill_file` returns the plugin's skill, not the open file, and variant (a)'s line ("Read it with load_skill_file(slug, file)") would be false. Built: the shadowed variant whenever the slug's registry winner is not the `project-rooted` source, valid package or not. The specification should name the valid-but-outranked case in the block's variants (or in the edge cases).
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-1302 — a VALID package outranked by another source is shadowed the same way as the invalid one the template names.
